independentLayers.description: The modal layer on the floating layer foundation (dom/floating.ts): top layer for backdrop and popup, dismiss layer (Escape, outside press), focus scope (trap and return), scroll lock, the rest of the page inert, nesting.
Reference numbers for the popup's padding, radius, gap, width and viewport margin.

intent: Interrupt to ask for a decision, usually confirming a destructive or irreversible action

properties.description: Whether the alert dialog is open. Setting it fires no openchange; a trigger press, Escape or a close part set it unless openchange is canceled.
Open at first connect when no open attribute is present (Base UI defaultOpen).
Text of a generated title (an h2 that names the popup): the question, such as "Delete project?". Ignored when the popup has an authored title.
Text of a generated description under the title (aria-describedby). Ignored when the popup has an authored description.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Sets the unit u (px) for this element and its subtree: one of the SIZES steps 2…12 (data-size is the same input). Lengths scale from u; type follows 10px + u.

attributes.name: gap
attributes.description: Gap between the popup's parts in units of u (0…8 in steps of 0.5); default the collection gap (2u).

events.name: openchange
events.trigger: the trigger is pressed, Escape is pressed or a close part is pressed (an outside press does nothing); preventDefault keeps the alert dialog as it is

keyboard.action: open the dialog (the trigger is a button)
close the alert dialog (the decision is cancel)
move focus among the popup's tabbables, wrapping

sources: the title (label property or an authored [data-part=title]) through aria-labelledby; the description (aria-describedby) states the consequence

content.children: Popup content, or authored [data-part=trigger], [data-part=backdrop] and [data-part=popup] children. Inside the popup: [data-part=title], [data-part=description], [data-part=actions] and [data-part=close] elements (usually ui-buttons): the cancel action is a close part and comes first; an [autofocus] element takes focus instead.

constraints: The host draws no box (display: contents; the manifest's layout schema has no contents value): only its trigger takes space in the page.
Always modal: the rest of the page is inert, page scroll is locked and focus is trapped until it closes; there is no modal attribute.
An outside press never closes it; Escape and the close parts do. Give it at least one close part (Cancel).
Focus starts on the least destructive action: an [autofocus] element, else the first close part, else the first tabbable.
The confirming action closes it only when it is also a close part; otherwise listen for its press and set open to false.
Setting open from script changes it without an openchange event.

avoidWhen.when: A form, settings or other content the user works in.
avoidWhen.reason: A dialog (ui-dialog) is for content; an alert dialog asks one question and closes.

avoidWhen.when: A notice that needs no decision.
avoidWhen.reason: Interrupting for information only trains users to dismiss alerts; show it in the page or as a toast.
